---
title: "Atlas Quality Control"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: 
  html_document:
    theme: flatly
    code_folding: hide
    self_contained: true
    toc: true
    toc_depth: 3
    toc_float: true
params:
  subject_id: ~
  disable_viewer: yes
  slice_zoom: 3
  underlay: ~
  atlas_name: ~
  atlas_path: ~
  atlas_colormap: ~
  atlas_search_radius: 2
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Report parameters (see `ravecore::generate_atlas_YBA`):
#   subject_id          : character(1), "project/subject"; required
#   disable_viewer      : logical(1), whether to omit the 3D viewer
#   slice_zoom          : numeric(1), zoom level of the per-electrode slices
#   underlay            : character(1) or NULL, path to the underlay volume;
#                         defaults to the subject T1 when missing
#   atlas_name          : character(1), e.g. "YBA696"
#   atlas_path          : character(1), absolute path, or a file name relative
#                         to the subject `fs/mri` folder
#   atlas_colormap      : character(1), absolute path to a color lookup table,
#                         or a file name shipped with `threeBrain`
#   atlas_search_radius : numeric(1), label search radius, in millimeters
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE
)

if (length(params$subject_id) != 1) {
  stop("Subject is missing.")
}
```

```{r initialize_paths}
# Load as RAVE subject
subject <- ravecore::as_rave_subject(params$subject_id, strict = TRUE)

# Load 3D brain
brain <- ravecore::rave_brain(subject, overlays = NULL, annotations = NULL)
if (is.null(brain)) {
  stop("Unable to find RAVE brain instance. Please process the subject in YAEL.")
}

underlay_path <- as.character(params$underlay)
if (length(underlay_path) != 1 || is.na(underlay_path) ||
    !file.exists(underlay_path)) {
  underlay_path <- as.character(
    brain$volumes$T1$group$group_data$volume_data$absolute_path)
  if (length(underlay_path) != 1 || is.na(underlay_path) ||
      !file.exists(underlay_path)) {
    stop("Unable to find the underlay (T1) volume. Please specify the ",
         "`underlay` parameter, or process the subject in YAEL first.")
  }
}

fs_path <- brain$base_path
fs_path_mri <- ravepipeline::dir_create2(file.path(fs_path, "mri"))

# Load atlas as overlay if provided
has_atlas <- FALSE

atlas_path <- params$atlas_path

if (length(atlas_path) == 1) {
  if (!file.exists(atlas_path)) {
    atlas_path <- file.path(fs_path_mri, atlas_path)
  }
  if (file.exists(atlas_path)) {
    has_atlas <- TRUE
  }
}

if (!has_atlas) {
  stop("Unable to find atlas file.")
}

atlas_name <- trimws(paste(params$atlas_name, collapse = ""))
if (!nzchar(atlas_name)) {
  atlas_name <- basename(atlas_path)
  atlas_name <- gsub("(_aseg|)\\.(nii|nii\\.gz)$", "", atlas_name)
}
atlas_volume <- ieegio::read_volume(atlas_path)

# Load colormap
atlas_colormap <- params$atlas_colormap
if (length(atlas_colormap) != 1) {
  # using default colormap
  atlas_colormap <- "FreeSurferColorLUT.json"
}

# Using threeBrain (YAEL) colormaps
if (file.exists(atlas_colormap)) {
  atlas_colormap_path <- atlas_colormap
} else {
  atlas_colormap_path <- system.file(
    "palettes", "datacube2", atlas_colormap, 
    package = "threeBrain")
}

if (atlas_colormap_path == "" || !file.exists(atlas_colormap_path)) {
  # Default colormap -> freesurfer lut
  atlas_colormap_path <- system.file(
    "palettes", "datacube2", "FreeSurferColorLUT.json", 
    package = "threeBrain")
}
atlas_colormap <- ieegio::read_colormap(atlas_colormap_path)

# Now we need to calculate colors
atlas_maxkey <- max(atlas_colormap$colors$color_table$Key, na.rm = TRUE)
atlas_palette <- vapply(
  seq(0, atlas_maxkey),
  function(key) {
    ieegio::calculate_color(x = key, atlas_colormap)
  },
  FUN.VALUE = ""
)

underlay <- ieegio::read_volume(underlay_path)

# `threeBrain` copy of the underlay, used by the per-electrode slice plots
underlay_volume <- threeBrain::read_volume(underlay_path)

electrode_table <- brain$electrodes$raw_table
has_electrodes <- is.data.frame(electrode_table) && nrow(electrode_table) > 0

# initialized_data <- list(
#   subject = subject,
#   brain = brain,
#   underlay_path = underlay_path,
#   atlas_name = atlas_name,
#   atlas_path = atlas_path,
#   atlas_colormap_path = atlas_colormap_path
# )

```

# Subject ID: ``r subject$subject_id``

```{r}
# Display the paths relative to the `FreeSurfer` folder when applicable
display_path <- function(path) {
  path <- normalizePath(path, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  root <- normalizePath(fs_path, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  if (startsWith(path, paste0(root, "/"))) {
    return(substring(path, nchar(root) + 2L))
  }
  path
}

# Message out
data.frame(
  Project = subject$project_name,
  Subject = subject$subject_code,
  UnderlayFile = display_path(underlay_path),
  AtlasFile = display_path(atlas_path),
  ColormapFile = display_path(atlas_colormap_path)
)
```

## Overview

```{r, layout="l-screen-insert-right"}
atlas_prefix <- gsub(
  "\\.(nii\\.gz|nii)$",
  "",
  basename(atlas_path),
  ignore.case = TRUE
)
brain$add_atlas(atlas_prefix, color_format = "RGBAFormat")

if (isTRUE(params$disable_viewer)) {
  message("Viewer is omitted...")
} else {
  brain$plot(
    # palettes = list(Label1 = colors),
    voxel_colormap = atlas_colormap_path,
    controllers = list(
      "Display Data" = "Label1",
      "Voxel Display" = "anat. slices",
      "Voxel Type" = atlas_prefix
    )
  )
}
```

### Axial

```{r overlay_inspection_axial, results='asis'}
ravecore::plot_volume_slices(
  underlay, overlay = atlas_volume, which = "axial", 
  nc = 6, depths = seq(-70, 85, length.out = 24), 
  overlay_col = atlas_palette, overlay_range = c(0, atlas_maxkey)
)
```

### Sagittal

```{r overlay_inspection_sagittal, results='asis'}
ravecore::plot_volume_slices(
  underlay, overlay = atlas_volume, which = "sagittal", 
  nc = 6, depths = seq(-70, 70, length.out = 24),
  overlay_col = atlas_palette, overlay_range = c(0, atlas_maxkey)
)
```
  
### Coronal

```{r overlay_inspection_coronal, results='asis'}
ravecore::plot_volume_slices(
  underlay, overlay = atlas_volume, which = "coronal", 
  nc = 6, depths = seq(-100, 70, length.out = 24),
  overlay_col = atlas_palette, overlay_range = c(0, atlas_maxkey)
)
```  


## Electrodes

### Table of atlas labels

Reproduce `r sprintf("electrode_atlas_%s.csv", atlas_name)` from the meta folder

```{r no_electrodes, eval=!has_electrodes, results='asis'}
cat("\nNo electrode contact has been localized for this subject.\n")
```

```{r label_table, eval=has_electrodes, layout="l-screen-insert-right"}
label_table <- brain$electrodes$get_atlas_labels(
  atlas = atlas_path,
  lut = threeBrain::load_colormap(atlas_colormap_path),
  radius = params$atlas_search_radius
)
label_table <- cbind(
  data.frame(Electrode = electrode_table$Electrode),
  label_table
)
rmarkdown::paged_table(
  label_table,
  options = list(rows.print = 20, rownames.print = FALSE)
)
```

Per-electrode results:


```{r slice_view, eval=has_electrodes, results='asis', out.width="100%", fig.width=12, fig.height=4.5, layout="l-screen-insert-right"}
slice_zoom <- params$slice_zoom

# label columns reported by `get_atlas_labels`, e.g. Label1, Label2, ...
label_columns <- grep("^Label[0-9]+$", names(label_table), value = TRUE)

dummy_output <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(electrode_table)), function(ii) {
  row <- electrode_table[ii, ]

  tmp <- sum(c(row$Coord_x, row$Coord_y, row$Coord_z, 0)^2)
  is_hidden <- isTRUE(is.na(tmp) || tmp == 0)

  if (is_hidden) {
    cat(sprintf("\n\n### Electrode %d - %s (hidden) {#electrode-slice-%d}\n\n",
              row$Electrode, row$Label, row$Electrode))
    return()
  }

  cat(sprintf("\n\n### Electrode %d - %s {#electrode-slice-%d}\n\n",
              row$Electrode, row$Label, row$Electrode))

  label_row <- label_table[ii, ]
  label_summary <- htmltools::tags$ul(
    class = "ul-compact",
    lapply(seq_along(label_columns), function(kk) {
      label_name <- label_row[[label_columns[[kk]]]]
      if (!length(label_name) || is.na(label_name) ||
          identical(as.character(label_name), "Unknown")) {
        if (kk == 1) {
          return(htmltools::tags$li("Unknown"))
        } else {
          return()
        }
      }

      # counts live in the label table (Count1, Count2, ...), not in the
      # electrode table
      count <- label_row[[sub("^Label", "Count", label_columns[[kk]])]]
      if (!length(count) || is.na(count)) {
        return(htmltools::tags$li(sprintf("`%s`\n", label_name)))
      }

      htmltools::tags$li(
        sprintf("`%s` (n = %d)\n", label_name, as.integer(count))
      )
    })
  )
  cat(as.character(label_summary), "\n")

  brain$plot_electrodes_on_slices(
    row$Electrode, elec_table = row,
    title_position = "top", verbose = FALSE,
    zoom = slice_zoom, volume = underlay_volume,
    adjust_brightness = FALSE)
})
```
